name: web-hig
description: Pin a versioned behavioral contract for web UX, accessibility, and AI coding agents.

scripts.pretest: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; if (!fs.existsSync('node_modules/@web-hig/core/package.json')) { console.error('Run npm install at repo root'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.test: node scripts/test/validate-hig.test.mjs && node scripts/test/golden-path.test.mjs && node packages/install/test/install.test.mjs && node packages/cli/test/check.test.mjs && node packages/cli/test/evaluator-report.test.mjs && node examples/audit-fixtures/motion-transition-regression/regression.spec.mjs
